tei:div.tei:p: 55) ༄/ dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag 'jig rten mchod bstod sgrub pa dregs pa dbang sdud ces bya ba bzhugs/ ༄༅/

bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin la phyag 'tshal lo: dur khrod chen po rab 'jigs par: byin gyis brlabs pa'i dben sa ru: sgrib sbyangs bsod nams gsog pa dang: bar chad bdud bzlog las la 'bad: mthun rdzas sa la pho brang bzhengs: dam tshig drag po'i rdzas kyis brgyan: thod mkhar bang mdzod ldan pa'am: e khroṃ grangs dang sbyar bar bya: dregs pa can gyi khyad par rdzas: mdzes pa'i gzugs brnyan sku yi rten: ming nas 'bod pa gsung gi rten: phyag mtshan dam pa thugs kyi rten: lug g.yag dkar po sbal sbrul nya: glang rta sngon po rin po che: g.yul shom myur sgrol bya gcan dang: snel bu shel nag phyar nag dang ཿ rta lcag khyi dang rgod zhag dang: ra phag bya khyi dkar po dang: kla klo ra rog dom khyi nag: sbrul nag bya rgod ra skyes dang: rta ra bya khyi dmar po yi: snying khrag mgo dang rgya mtshan gzugs: phyi rol sgo sogs brgya: brtsegs ldan: dur khrod chen po mngon du phyung: ri rab bshos gtsang rgyan ldan sogs: mthun rdzas bskang rdzas ci 'byor bshams: dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub gzhung gi: bskyed rim bsgyur tshul 'di ltar ro: 56) 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang cheḥ rab 'jigs gnam lcags tsakra rtsibs bzhi pa'iḥ dbus su nyi zla pad+ma dang ཿ ro bzhi bsnol ba'i steng nyid duḥ bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul niḥ dbu dgu phyag ni bco brgyad deḥ sku mdog mthing nag khro zhing rngamaḥ g.yas kyi zhal gsum smug nag bgradaḥ g.yon gyi zhal gsum kham nag gtsigasaḥ dbu skra ral pa me dpung 'baraḥ spyan dgu sdang mig bzlog cing bgradaḥ shangs nas srid pa'i rlung nag 'thoraḥ snyan nas stong gsum 'brug sgra ldiraḥ sma ra ag tshom me ltar 'baraḥ mche gtsigs srid gsum rtsa ba gcodaḥ phyag dgu g.yas g.yon dang po yisaḥ rdo rje thod khrag dkrug cing gsolaḥ g.yas kyi 'og ma'i phyag brgyad naḥ dregs pa lha chen brgyad bsgral ba'iḥ g.yang gzhi mgo bo bcas te bsnamasaḥ

g.yon gyi 'og ma'i phyag brgyad naḥ klu chen brgyad kyi bhan+dha ruḥ dregs pa'i snying khrag bkang nas gsolaḥ dpa' 57) ba'i chas brgyad sku la gsolaḥ zhabs brgyad brkyangs bskum 'dor stabs kyisaḥ khams gsum bdag po sde bzhi mnanaḥ yum chen khams gsum spyi 'dul maḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis mthing nag skuḥ rdo rje 'phyar zhing thod khrag stobasaḥ gtso dang gnyis med sbyor ba lasaḥ thabs dang shes rab 'od zer gyisaḥ e u'i rnam pa sa bon tshulaḥ 'phro 'dus gri gug kha ṭaṃ gsalaḥ de nyid gsal ba'i rgyu sbyangs pasaḥ g.yas su lha chen dbang phyug cheḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing ཿ phyag g.yas gri gug tsit+ta g.yonaḥ g.yon du u ma de ba niḥ sku mdog mthing nag gtso la 'dudaḥ phyag g.yas rtse gsum thod khrag g.yonaḥ seng ge glang chen gdan la bzhugasaḥ yab yum gnyis med thugs ka nasaḥ ya ma dun+tiṃ rak+sha yak+shaḥ phyogs bzhir 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi'i steng ཿ bdud kyi rgyal po sde dpon niḥ khram shing g.yas la dgra s+t+wa 58) g.yonaḥ bdud rta nag po'i khri la bzhugasaḥ sbyor yum bdud mo re ma tiḥ khram bam g.yas la nad rkyal g.yonaḥ bong bu ga dmar gdan la bzhugasaḥ gshin rje'i sde dpon chen po niḥ be con g.yas la thod dbyug g.yonaḥ sbyor yum gshin rje za byed moḥ phyag gnyis srid pa'i 'khor lo skoraḥ yab yum ma he chu glang zhonaḥ srin po'i sde dpon glog phreng canaḥ phyag gnyis thog ser 'dril zhing 'phenaḥ srin mo sbal mgo khrag mig maḥ phyag g.yas phur pa khrag phor g.yonaḥ yab yum 'brug dang rnga mo zhonaḥ gnod sbyin sde dpon me bal canaḥ phyag g.yas rin chen g.yon ral griḥ sbyor yum gnod sbyin nag mo niḥ phyag g.yas spu gri g.yon spyang moḥ stag seng phag mo zhabs kyis gnonaḥ steng du gza' bdud sde dpon cheḥ phyag g.yas mda' gzhu g.yon sbrul zhagasaḥ sku smad sbrul 'khyil 'brug chen gnonaḥ sbyor yum thog gi bu yug canaḥ

g.yas g.yon phyag gis thog ser 59) 'bebs: zhabs gnyis 'brug mo kha gdangs gnonaḥ 'og tu klu rgyal ded dpon cheḥ phyag g.yas sbrul zhags g.yon nad rkyalaḥ sbyor yum klu mo nag mo niḥ sbrul mgo phyag mtshan g.yas kyi tshulaḥ yab yum chu srin rus sbal gnonaḥ kun kyang sku mdog mthing nag maḥ khros pa'i cha byad 'jigs tshul canaḥ dur khrod g.yang gzhi'i chas kyis brgyanaḥ dhe ba tri dza du triḥ shar du dkar po'i sde dpon gsumaḥ gnod sbyin lha yi sde dpon niḥ shel gri ba dan dkar po 'dzinaḥ rgod dkar ru bzang zhabs kyis gnonaḥ gnam rgyal chen po'i sde dpon niḥ phyag g.yas ldan dkar g.yon shel griḥ rta dkar rngog dmar zhabs kyis gnonaḥ spyi bdud rgyal po gu rum ceḥ phyag g.yas ba dan g.yon shel griḥ zhabs gnyis rdo rta gro bo gnonaḥ ya ma dza ti dhā ki maṃḥ lho ru nag mo'i sde dpon gsumaḥ srid pa ma mo'i sde dpon moḥ 'khor lo 60) g.yas la me long g.yonaḥ zhabs gnyis 'brug mo mgo dgu gnonaḥ sngags kyi srung ma chen mo niḥ tsit+ta g.yas la g.yu spyang g.yonaḥ dre'u rta nag lo zhabs kyis gnonaḥ mkha' 'gro nag mo mgyogs byed maḥ nad rkyal g.yon la mtshon gru+u g.yasaḥ po bya nag po chibs su chibasaḥ rū tra a bhi haṃ shaṃḥ nub tu dmar po'i sde dpon gsumaḥ rdo rje bdud 'dul chen mo niḥ g.yas g.yon phyag gis thun khrag 'phenaḥ brag btsan srog zan dmar po niḥ mda' gzhu 'phen cing dar dmar 'phyaraḥ che btsan 'gong gi rgyal po niḥ shag lang dang ni zhags pa 'dzinaḥ kun kyang rta dmar zhabs kyis gnonaḥ be tri tir+thi dmu duḥ byang du nag po'i sde dpon gsumaḥ bi na ya ka bgegs kyi rgyalaḥ phyag g.yas kha ṭ+wām̐ g.yon thod khragaḥ phyi rol skyong ba'i mu stegs gtsoḥ tri shul g.yas la thod khrag g.yonaḥ dmu bdud nag po bkrag med niḥ mda' gzhu 61) dang ni shang lang 'dzinaḥ bdud rta nag po zhabs kyis gnonaḥ tri yaṃ ra tri pa tri na triḥ

shar lho nub byang sgo bzhi ruḥ tshangs pa'i rgyal po srog gi bdagaḥ spu gri g.yas la nyi zhags g.yonaḥ seng ge dkar po zhabs kyis gnonaḥ bdud kyi rgyal po nor gyi bdagaḥ bdud zhags g.yas la spu gri g.yonaḥ ban glang rna rengs zhabs kyis gnonaḥ nag po chen po tshogs kyi bdagaḥ phyag g.yas beng chen g.yon gri gugaḥ rta nag mgyogs pa zhabs kyis gnonaḥ sku mdog dkar ser dmar nag mdzesaḥ sde dpon dregs pa thams cad kyang ཿ khros shing gdug pa'i tshul 'chang zhing ཿ na bza' g.yang gzhi 'jigs pa'i chasaḥ sna tshogs mdzes pa'i rgyan dang ldanaḥ phyi rol khyams la dregs pa canaḥ so so'i 'khor g.yog mang po dgaḥ bka' nyan gsung sdod tshul du gnasaḥ oṃ āḥhūm̐: oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ṭa sarba duṇ+ṭan ta ka ha na da ha pa tsa hūm̐ phaṭaḥ sku gsung thu+ugs 62) ldan byin rlabs cing ཿ rdo rje 'chang bas dbang bskur roḥ 'jig rten rang rgyud so so yiḥ gnas nas 'od kyis bskul ba dang ཿ ting nge 'jin gyi tshul 'dra baḥ rang rang gzugs brnyan lus la bstimaḥ de nas spyan 'dren pa na ིཿ hūm̐: thugs rje rnam dag dbyings kyi dkyil 'khor nasaḥ chos sku stong nyid dbyings las ma g.yos kyang ཿ 'jig rten dregs pa'i tshogs rnams 'dul ba'i phyiraḥ khro chen dpa' gtum 'jigs byed skur bstan paḥ thugs dam dgyes pa gsang ba'i yum dang bcasaḥ ma rtogs shugs kyis 'dul phyir gshegs su gsolaḥ dregs pa'ali dbang phyug 'jig rten lha yi gtsoḥ 'dod pa'i lha mo bde chen 'byung gnas maḥ 'khor tshogs drag shul mthu stobs dbang phyug bdagaḥ khro gtum gdug pa'i rtsal 'chang dpal dang ldanaḥ rdo rje 'chang ba'i bka' bzhin rjes su sgrubaḥ dam tshig rjes dgongs gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan a ta ya na e dza bh+yo: a gad dza:sa ma ya hring hring ཿ bzhugs gsol ni: dud khrod gsang ba mchog gi dkyil 'khor 63) 'diraḥ lha chen nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng duḥ

bcom ldan khro rgyal rngam brjid 'bar ba'i skuḥ yab yum dgyes par rol cing bzhugs su gsolaḥ snang srid dregs pa ma lus sde dpon gtsoḥ 'dod khams bdag po dgyes mdzad yum dang bcasaḥ lha srin tshogs kyi gtso chen 'khor dang bcasaḥ phrin las mthun pa'i gdan la bzhugs su gsolaḥ badz+ra sarba duṇ+ṭan a ta na ya e dza bh+yoḥ sa ma ya tiṇ+ṭha badz+ra dza:hūm̐ baṃ hoḥ phyag 'tshal ni/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thugs kyi snying po mchogaḥ chos kyi sku las gzugs sku 'gro don sprulaḥ che btsan 'gran zla med pa khro bo'i rjeḥ dbang sdud yum dang bcas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba ma lus sras dang bcasaḥ dam chos bstan pa'i chos bsrung 'jig rten mgonaḥ zhing bcu sgrol mdzad phrin las drag shul canaḥ sde dpon sum cu'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal loḥ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan a ta na ya e dza bh+yoḥ na ma ā ra li hoḥ mchod pa ni/ 64) dpal chen dregs pa kun 'dul yab yum laḥ sku gsung thugs ma mnyes mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ gdugs dang rgya mtshan ba dan bla re dang: phreng ba phye ma lda ldi za ra tshagasaḥ bdug spos me tog mar me chab bsil dang ཿ gzugs mdzes sgra snyan dri zhim ro bro dang ཿ reg 'jam 'dod yon ma lus ji snyed paḥ 'phags pa'i thun mong mchod tshogs bzhes su gsolaḥ khyad par gsang ba'i mchod pa 'bul ba niḥ dug gsum gnas su sbyangs pa'i sha khrag rusaḥ dug lnga sman du grub pa'i dam tshig rdzasaḥ stabs mchog nus pa ba ling mchod pa'i dngosaḥ thugs rje mthun pa'i ngang gis bzhes su gsolaḥ dpal chen yab yum bka' bzhin rjes sgrub pa'iḥ dbang phyug chen po yab yum mnga' bdag rjeḥ 'jig rten 'das kyang 'khor ba'i cha lugs 'dzinaḥ bka' yi bstan srung sde dpon sum cu laḥ 'dod pa'i yon tan mchod cing sbyin pa niḥ dkar dmar ser ljang la sogs mdogaḥ zlum po gru bzhi la sogs dbyibasaḥ che chung sbo ma phra 65)ring thung tshadaḥ

mdzes dang mi mdzes sdug mi sdugaḥ 'byung ba rten 'brel rol mo'i sgraḥ glu tshig bstod dbyangs snyan pa'i tshigaḥ spos sman bdud rtsi me tog driḥ bsregs gsur bam sogs dri dang ngad/ kha mngar tsha skyur ska ba dang ཿ lan tsha spod dang bye skyu dang ཿ 'jam rtsub bsil yang tsha dang broḥ so so'i yon tan tshor dang bcasaḥ 'dod gur 'bul gyis bzhes su gsolaḥ bdud rtsi lnga dang sha sna lngaḥ don snying lnga dang 'byung ba lnga: dbang po lnga dang yul lnga dang ཿ phung po lnga dang nang rol lngaḥ 'tshe zhing gsod dang bar du gcodaḥ gdug par sems shing log par ltaḥ mi mthun phyogs lngar bcas pa rnamasaḥ so sor 'bul gyis bzhes su gsolaḥ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan a ta na ya e dza bh+yoḥ ma hā ba lit+taḥ aṛ taḥ su ka ta mang sa rak+ta si ba ta ba su ta ba ma thāḥ i daṃ gṛh+ṇan+tu sa ma du kha kha khā hi khā hi: dngos grub gsol ba ni/ bcom ldan dpal chen 66) dregs pa kun 'dul dang ཿ yum chen khams gsum spyi 'dul 'khor bcas kyisaḥ sku mdog 'gyur med me long gzugs brnyan bzhinaḥ gsal zhing rtog med snang ba ma 'gags paḥ sku lnga lhun grub rdzogs pa'i dngos grub stsolaḥ gsung mchog 'gag med brag cha sgra brnyan bzhinaḥ snyan dang mi snyan grags stong tshangs pa'i gsung ཿ gsung dbyangs nam mkha'i mtha' khyab dngos grub stsolaḥ yon tan brjod kyis mi langs sna tshogs teḥ 'das dang ma 'das mchog dang thun mong giḥ grub pa brgyad dang mthar thug dngos grub stsolaḥ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan arta na ya e dza ka ya sid+dhi bāka sid+dhi tsit+ta sid+dhi gu ṇa sid+dhi karma sid+dhi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ḥ bstod pa rgyas par rgyud ltar ram/ bsdu naḥ bcom ldan dregs pa kun 'dul dang: yum chen khams gsum spyi 'dul maḥ gnyis med 67) thugs kyi phrin las kyis: 'jig rten dregs pa bran du 'kholaḥ lha srin sde brgyad las la 'gyedaḥ dgra bgegs gdug pa rtsad nas gcodaḥ khro rgyal gtso la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ

dpal gyi bka' bzhin las mdzad pa'iḥ sde dpon dregs pa kun gyi gtsoḥ lha chen yab yum sku la bstodaḥ phyag bzhi steng 'og gnas bzhugs pa'iḥ dregs pa'i sde dpon 'di dag niḥ rang gi tshogs 'dul phrin las mdzadaḥ yab yum bcas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dkar po'i sde dpon chen po gsumaḥ shar phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ nag mo'i sde dpon ma mo gsumaḥ lho phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ dmar po'i sde dpon rgyal po gsumaḥ nub phyogs skyong la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ nag po'i tshogs kyis sde dpon gsumaḥ byang phyogs gnas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ phyogs kyi sde dpon chen po bzhiḥ sgo bzhir gnas la phyag 'tshal bstodaḥ sde dpon dregs pa 'di dag niḥ rang gi 'khor g.yog tshogs kyis bskoraḥ sprul pa'i 68) cho 'phrul bsam mi khyabaḥ mchod bstod chen po khyod bsgrubs nasaḥ so so'i tshogs 'dul phrin las mdzodaḥ dzab+da ni/ rdo rje 'dzin pa'i sku gsung thugasaḥ gsal brtan tshad dang ldan pa yiḥ nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' khyab kunaḥ rang gi yul gsum gsal bar dmigasaḥ dregs pa'i sde dpon re re'i drung ཿ rdul snyed 'dul byed gnyen po gnasaḥ phal pa re re'i gnas drung duḥ sde dpon chen po de bzhin bsamaḥ bka' nyan gsung sdod g.yo mi nusaḥ cung tsam 'da' bar mi spyod cing ཿ rang gi 'dod pa mi spobs laḥ skad cig tsam la don sgrub dmigasaḥ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭaḥ thog mtha' oṃ dang phaṭa bzhag nasaḥ bar du 'bru brgyad grogs gnas paḥ dregs pa 'dus pa'i snying po yinaḥ phyi ma phyi ma'i brgyud las/ oṃ badz+ra tsaṇ+ḍa dregs pa kun 'dus gyi snying poḥ sarba duṣ+ṭan dregs pa can sum cu'i stobasaḥ hūm̐ yab yum khams gsum spyi 'dul maḥ yab yum gyi phan du dregs pa can bcug pa stobs dbang du sdud pa'oḥ phaṭa:kyis stobs 'phrog pa'oḥ dregs pa can dbang du sdud pa'i tshul du bzla par bya'oḥ zhes gsungs so/

gzhan 'bod rbad bsad sngags gi rgyud la blta'o/ rjes ky-i rim pa dpal chen gzhung ltar ro/ 'jig rten mchod bstod 'dus pa rtsa ba'i rgyud las bkol ba'ang ma hā shṛ maṅgalo/ 69) dpal chen bka' 'dus rgya mtsho'i cha lag dmod pa drag sngags sgrub pa dgra bgegs snying 'byin bzhugs/ ༄༅/ bcom ldan 'das mthu stobs thams cad kyi bdag po la phyag 'tshal lo: dud khrod chu gling ri rtse dang: chu 'dus ngam grog 'jigs su rung: phung shul nags khrod ma rungs par: dregs pa'i gtso 'khor dmigs pa'i rten: lte bar 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi la: bar khyams phyogs bzhir sgo bzhi bcas: rta nag drel nag ma he dang: chu glang dang ni stag seng dang: rta dkar ne tso rgod dkar dang: dom nag dmu rta ba glang dang: 'brug chen rma bya rus sbal dang: bya khyi ku ku shel dang mi: rgya mtshan thod pa snying dang khrag: bdud rtsi 'bru bcud byang chub sems: rang gzugs snying po 'khor lo bcas: rgyan ldan bshos cha mthun rdzas bshams: dpal chen 'dus pa'i sgrub gzhung gi: 'og min gsang chen rol pa'i pho brang cheḥ gtum drag me ltar 'bar ba'i gzhal yas naḥ gdug byed rū tra ti ra'i khri steng nasaḥ mdangs ldan pad+ma nyi zla'i gdan steng duḥ dregs pa'i bdag po rdo rje 'dzin pa'i gtsoḥ bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag po niḥ sku mdog mthing nag rab tu 'bar: sa dgu rdzogs pa'i dbu dgu bstanaḥ stong 70) pa bco brgyad ldan pa'i phyagaḥ zhabs kyis 'jigs pa'i bdud bzhi gnonaḥ dbus mthing g.yas dkar yon dmar baḥ khro zhing bzhed dang gtsigs pa'i zhalaḥ ral pa kham nag srid rtser 'baraḥ khams gsum ma lus spyan gyis gzigasaḥ shangs kyis srid gsum ma lus rngubaḥ snyan gyis stong gsum 'brug sgras 'geng ཿ tshem gyis gnod gdug ma lus sgrolaḥ ljags kyis glog dmar 'jig rten khyabaḥ khro gnyer 'od kyis dbang du sdudaḥ phrin las rigs kyis dbu la brgyanaḥ

bco brgyad phyag gi dang po gnyisaḥ dbang sdud rdo rje dril bu 'dzinaḥ g.yas g.yon 'og ma'i phyag brgyad naḥ dregs pa'i lha brgyad bha n+dha g.yasaḥ tsit+ta srog rtsa g.yon na bsnamasaḥ 'bar ba'i chas kyis sku la brgyanaḥ srung ba'i lha brgyad sku la rdzogasaḥ g.yas g.yon zhabs kyis dregs pa gziraḥ ma rungs 'dul dka' rnams kyi gshedaḥ log lta rūtra 'dul ba'i dpalaḥ 'byung lnga'i bdag mo gnyis med yumaḥ dbu gsum phyag 71) drug zhabs bzhi sbyoraḥ gri gug tri shul bdud rtsi g.yasaḥ bhan+dha zhing chen g.yang gzhi g.yonaḥ mthing nag 'od kyis kun tu khyabaḥ mched 'ga' rigs kyi sprul pa naḥ dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgradaḥ sku mdog mthing nag khros shing rngamaḥ phyag drug g.yas g.yon dang po yisaḥ rdo rje dung khrag dkrug cing gsolaḥ g.yas g.yon 'og ma'i phyag bzhi yis: lha brgyad klu brgyad tsit+ta rolaḥ yum chen zhal gcig phyag gnyis laḥ sku mdog mthing nag zhabs gnyis sbyoraḥ g.yas kyis nam mkha' stong khams lding: g.yon gyis 'jig rten sa gzhi gnonaḥ zhal nas 'byung ba lnga 'char maḥ dpal chen yum gyi byin brlabs lasaḥ sprul pa'i dregs pa pho mo'i gtsoḥ bdud nag me'i 'khor lo canaḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog mthing ཿ khram shing tri shul g.yas na bsnams ཿ g.yon gyi kha ṭ+wam̐ zhags pa 'phenaḥ na bza' zhing lpags rlon pa gsolaḥ 72)zhabs gnyis gdug pa'i snying la gziraḥ yum chen bdud mo khrag 'dzag maḥ khraṃ baṃ thod rlon phyag na bsnamasaḥ sku la zhing lpags gsar pa bgosaḥ bdud rta nag po chibs su bcibasaḥ zhabs kyis dgra bgegs shugs kyis sgrolaḥ 'chi bdag gshin rje nag po niḥ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog nagaḥ phyag g.yas thod khrag gri gug g.yon: btsun mo yum chen za byed maḥ gri gug thod pa phyag na bsnamasaḥ yab yum zhing lpags rlon pa gsolaḥ ma he khros dang chu glang bcibasaḥ zhabs kyis dgra bgegs pho mo gziraḥ srin po gsod byed sku mdog nagaḥ

phyag na ral gri thod khrag bsnamasaḥ yum chen gsod par byed pa moḥ gri gug mi thod phyag na bsnamasaḥ na bza' zhing lpags rlon pa gsolaḥ stag sing rngam pa'i chibs su bcibs: gnod sbyin gang ba bzang po yang ཿ zhal gcig phyag gnyis sku mdog sngoḥ dar nag phyar zhing zhing lpags rdebaḥ yum chen sha za ral gcig maḥ yab kyi tshul 'dzin grub 73)pa poḥ zhing lpags gyon te gyi ling bcibs: drag sngags bdag po chen po niḥ dbang phyug chen po lha yi gtso: mdog dkar shel grib ba dan 'phyaraḥ na bza' dar dkar ber chen gsolaḥ chibs su gnam ru dkar po bcibasaḥ thar pa nag po ru tra'i gtsoḥ mchod gtor dug thun phyag na bsnamasaḥ zhing lpags gon ste dom nag bcibasaḥ dmu bdud rje dpon nag po niḥ dar nag 'phyar zhing ti ra 'bradaḥ ber nag gsol zhing dmu rta bcibasaḥ mu stegs ka la yak+sha niḥ mthing nag kha ṭ+waṃ' tri shul 'dzinaḥ zhing lpags gon te ma he bcibasaḥ khyab 'jug rog te nag po yang ཿ khram shing dgra s+t+wa phyag gis 'dzinaḥ sprin nag bshos shing 'brug sngon bcibasaḥ klu rgyal bā ru na yi rjeḥ ser nag sbrul gyi na bza' gsolaḥ bum pa rus sbal phyag gis 'dzinaḥ chibs su

chu srin mgo dgu bcibasaḥ rgyal po har mdzes zhes bya yang ཿ mdog dkar shel gri dar dkar 'dzinaḥ khu le 74)lag dgu 'bar ba yang ཿ mdog ser sprul pa'i lag dgu 'gyedaḥ zhing lpags gon shing ti ra gnonaḥ rang gi sde dang dpung dang bcasaḥ ma lus dregs pa can gyi tshogasaḥ bka' nyan gsung sdod tshul du gnasaḥ hūm̐ḥ rang las shar ba'i dpal chen lhaḥ zhes sogs dpal chen gzhung ltar laḥ spyan 'dren gyi mal dag tu/ hūm̐ḥ rnam dag mnyam pa chen po'i ngang nyid lasaḥ rig pa'i dbyings las skye ba med mod kyang ཿ skye ba'i cho 'phrul drag sngags lha tshogs rnamasaḥ chos kyi dbyings las gnas 'dir gshegs su gsolaḥ e h+ya hi dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya hriṃ hriṃ dzaḥdzaḥ bzhugs gsol la sogs gzhung ltar la/ bstod pa niḥ hūm̐ḥ dur khrod chen po rol pa'i dkyil 'khor nasaḥ bcom ldan dpal chen stobs ldan nag po dang ཿ gnyis med yum chen 'byung lnga'i bdagaḥ dregs pa'i bdag po gtso 'khor bcasaḥ rang gi rigs kyi 'khor 'dul baḥ so so'i sprul pa bsam mi khyabaḥ gcod par byed pa bdud kyi sdeḥ 'ching bar byed pa btsan gyi sdeḥ gsod byed 75) shan pa srin po'i sdeḥ gdug rtsub 'chang ba gnod sbyin sdeḥ drag rtsal ldan pa lha yi sdeḥ nad gdon 'bebs pa ma mo'i sdeḥ nam mkha'i dbang sgyur gza' yi sdeḥ glan lkugs gdug pa klu yi sdeḥ sde brgyad dmod pa'i drag sngags canaḥ mthu dang rdzu 'phrul bsam mi khyab: 'khor dang sde rigs brjod mi lang ཿ phrin las mi zad longs spyod gteraḥ yon tan nus pa dpag tu medaḥ zhe sdang can la khros par stonaḥ 'dod chags can la mi sdug stonaḥ gti mug can la myos par stonaḥ ser sna can la 'phrog par stonaḥ phrag dog can la 'jigs par stonaḥ khyed kyi mi 'dul gcig med kyiḥ mchod cing bskang ba'i mthun rdzas bzhesaḥ bcol zhing gnyer ba'i las mdzod cigaḥ bstod cing sgrub pas dgyes par mdzodaḥ

dzab+da ni/ bdag nyid stobs ldan gsal ba lasaḥ dregs pa ma lus gzir byed cing ཿ khams gsum dregs pa gnad la boraḥ de nyid sde brgyad las la 'gyedaḥ bstan pa'i 76)srung mar dbang bskur roḥ oṃ badz+ra sarba duṣ+ṭan hūm̐ phaṭaḥ thog mtha' oṃ dang phaṭaḥbazhag nasaḥ bar du grong khyer drug gnas paḥ dregs pa gzir ba'i snying po yinaḥ phyi ma phyi ma'i rgyud las/ oṃ badz+ra stobs ldan nag po'i snying poḥ sarba dregs pa can sngags bdag bco brgyad: duṣ+ṭan gzir zhing gnon paḥ hūm̐ 'byung ba lnga'i bdag mo: yab yum gyis dregs pa can dbang du bcug la gzir ba'o/ phaṭa kyis gzir zhing gcod pa'oḥ dregs can gzir ba'i don du bzlas pa'oḥ zhes gsungs so/ las kyi sbyor ba rgyud las shes so/ drag sngags 'dus pa rdo rje rtsa ba'i rgyud las bkol ba'ang ma hā shri saṅgaso/ /
